description: This Kotlin source file defines the NotesDatabaseHelper class, which manages SQLite database operations for a notes app. It provides CRUD methods and database schema details.

classes.name: NotesDatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing notes stored in an SQLite database, including creation, upgrades, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and an index on the updated_at column during database initialization.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database upgrades by dropping existing tables and recreating them, with a note about migration best practices.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns the created Note object with the generated ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID, returning true if the update was successful.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning true if a row was deleted.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by last updated time descending.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches notes where the title or content contains the given query string.

methods.name: queryNotes
methods.description: Internal helper to query notes with optional selection criteria.

methods.name: readNote
methods.description: Creates a Note object from the current position of a database cursor.
